about.title: Neighbors lifting neighbors.
about.intro: RISE — Resourceful Impact in Scholastic Education — is a North Texas nonprofit that meets families where they are: at the table, in the classroom and at the school pantry.
about.story1: RISE started with a single community meal and a simple idea: when people sit down together, nobody is invisible. What began as one table in Mount Pleasant grew into a network of meals, school pantries and clothing drives across North Texas.
about.story2: Today we partner with schools and organizations like Communities In Schools of Greater Tarrant County to keep pantries stocked, keep students in school and open doors from middle school all the way to a career.
about.mission: RISE uplifts individuals in need through empowerment, education, and community service for a brighter future.
